description: Asks how omission of an optional argument compares with explicit Null, Empty and typed replacements for Nz, Mid, InStr and Round, each expression in its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One, and with Empty and the optional-argument marker through an undeclared parameter in Nz([pv]) and Nz([pv], 0). Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT Nz([pv]) AS v FROM One
SELECT Nz([pv], 0) AS v FROM One
